svg.title: Reliva delivery pipeline and release procedure
svg.desc: A merge to main runs tests, builds four images into GHCR and sends one SSM command to the single EC2 host, whose release script checks out the commit, takes a pre-deploy dump, migrates, starts the stack, checks health and rolls back automatically on failure.
svg.text: From merge to a running release
GitHub Actions builds images into GHCR and sends one SSM command; the host pulls, migrates, checks health and can roll back.
AWS EC2 · AP-SOUTHEAST-2 · /opt/c48 · RUNS AS ROOT VIA SSM
CI only: lint, compose-env, jest, script tests
build 4 images, push nothing, no deploy
tag = commit SHA · docker build + sharp checked
deploy job runs when DEPLOY_ENABLED = true
production environment secrets, main branch only
this one instance. Rotate ~90 days · OIDC = upgrade path
Cloudflare Tunnel · fails the run if it does not answer
public packages: no pull token on the host
pipeline then checks the public URL
health check again · exit non-zero → red run
only if a migration changed data incompatibly:
restore pre-deploy dump with the restore script
loses writes made since the release
• First automated deploy: SSM sent, 4 images pulled, migrations 9 / 17 / 16 applied, all health checks passed.
• Rollback and the pre-deploy dump are covered by tests with fake docker/git/curl; no real failure has been rehearsed yet.
• The first run failed once on 'Permission denied' (db/migrate not executable) and was fixed in the release script.
SSM SEND COMMAND · IAM USER KEY
